ReviewProbe.Scope: One fresh strictly read-only review of all 15 changed files and reachable Code93/QR callers: localized parsing and checksums, direction/polarity, bounds, cancellation, candidate selection, perspective coordinates, sampling and acceptance, target compatibility, fixtures and dependency isolation.
Limits: Full qualification, frozen comparisons and measured performance remain primary-owned gates.
Stored tests inspected; no independent execution.
Local fixture provenance verified; no upstream fetch.
No publication, merge or release claim.

ChangedDecoders: Code93 image localization searches guarded symbol boundaries within longer scanlines in either direction and polarity. Localized candidates require both existing Code93 checksums and the termination bar; complete checksum-free symbol compatibility remains. Checksum arithmetic is shared by encoder and decoder. Search is bounded and retains cancellation and shared recognition budgets.

Modern QR perspective sampling fits the three observed finder centers and an existing alignment center with the existing perspective transform. The fitted mapping uses the module-center coordinate convention and existing corner sampler without an additional affine phase. The previous approximate alignment fallback, bounds, ECC, payload acceptance, search limits and deadlines remain. No public API or production dependency is added.
AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 195/267 correct positive images versus 191/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: none; gained: code93-1/2.png, qrcode-1/6.png, qrcode-5/11.png, qrcode-5/09.png. Paired negative completion is [30, 30, 31, 30]/31 with the current binary and [30, 30, 30, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. Code93 localization retains checksum and termination checks, while QR perspective fitting uses observed finder and alignment centers with the existing sampler and acceptance checks. Recognition budgets and search limits remain unchanged. Demonstrated regression gains do not establish accuracy on unseen photographs. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported.

RegressionProof.Coverage: Code93 independent framed diagram through three public APIs; reverse, vertical and inverted framed symbols; corrupt C/K and missing termination rejection; complete checksum-free compatibility. QR independent perspective bookmark through single, multi-result and scanner APIs with the original 1500 ms allowance. Existing photograph, rotated QR, multi-symbol, parity and nested-budget contracts remain covered.

QrBaseline.Scope: Code93 source fix is present; QR production source is unchanged from the previous qualification.

ProbeCorrection.Reason: Independent decoder mutates its input. The corrected probe copies its sampled grid before decoding; both module decoders then succeed.

RegressionProof.HistoricalProof: Earlier QR, Data Matrix and PDF417 qualification remains historical in previous-qualification.json. Current full suites and frozen/supplemental outcomes are rerun.

TestExecution.Net472: Task-local runner configuration disables collection parallelism; recognition allowances and assertions are unchanged.
TestExecution.Limit: Short wall-clock allowances remain sensitive to shared-host load. Serial legacy qualification is not proof for default parallel execution.

SupplementalPdf417.Selection: All PNG images with UTF-8 text oracles in pdf417-1, pdf417-2 and pdf417-3, excluding the 18 frozen comparison images. The 38-image selection was fixed before the first supplemental outcomes. One revealed regression informed the final correction and permanent fixture; the final set is supplemental regression evidence, not an unseen holdout.
SupplementalPdf417.Limit: Supplemental images from the same upstream collection, outside the 18 frozen comparison images. The initial check exposed a sampling-priority regression that was repaired and added to permanent tests. This is regression evidence used during remediation, not an unseen holdout for the final candidate, a replacement ranking, or proof on an independent dataset. Wall-clock budgets also limit attribution of changed outcomes.

TimedDecodingDiagnostics.Scope: Exploratory public scanner checks with preloaded pixels, two warmups, six retained observations per image, original 1500 ms allowance, CCD0 affinity and normal priority. Previous host precedes current on a shared machine; this is not a fair performance ranking. Frozen corpus and rotated timing lanes remain authoritative.
